d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 6 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.

Calo is building a stronger organic presence in the UAE, and we’re looking for a content creator who can turn ideas, trends and everyday Calo moments into content people genuinely want to watch and engage with.

You’ll own the day-to-day organic content engine across Instagram and TikTok, helping Calo build a recognizable voice, grow its audience and make organic social a meaningful source of attention in the UAE.
q: Experience creating content for Instagram and TikTok, ideally for a brand or consumer-focused business.
Strong understanding of social media trends, formats and what makes content engaging.
Hands-on skills in shooting, editing, scripting and copywriting.
Strong understanding of the UAE audience, culture and social media landscape.
Fluent in English and Arabic, with the ability to create naturally in both.
Strong creative thinking with the ability to turn simple ideas into engaging content.
Comfortable being on camera or using voiceover when needed, while also being able to build content around other people, characters and formats.
Data-aware and curious about what makes content perform.
Highly organized and able to manage content from idea to publication.
Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment.
You naturally spot content opportunities everywhere.
You understand that great social content is about more than just following trends.
You’re creative, curious and not afraid to experiment.
You care about both the quality of the content and the results it delivers.
You move quickly, learn from what works and are always looking for the next idea.
You’re organized enough to turn creativity into a consistent content engine.
You understand local culture and know how to make content feel relevant, natural and authentic to the UAE audience.
Screening meeting with our TA team
r: li
Own Calo UAE’s organic content strategy and content calendar across Instagram and TikTok.
li

li
Create content end-to-end, from ideation and scripting to shooting, editing, copywriting and publishing.
li
Create content in both English and Arabic based on the audience and format.
li
Stay close to UAE trends, conversations and culture to spot opportunities for Calo.
li
Work with products, people, locations and internal teams to bring content ideas to life.
li
Build recurring content formats, characters and series that people can recognize and come back to.
li
Manage day-to-day organic channels, including monitoring comments, reactions and audience feedback.
li
Track content performance and use insights to improve future content.
li
Test different hooks, formats, topics, video lengths, CTAs and creative approaches.
li
Keep the content pipeline, calendar and footage library organized and easy for the wider team to use.
li
Work closely with the UAE Marketing Lead, Affiliates & Influencers Manager and wider marketing team to stay aligned on priorities and campaigns.

d: Locations: Ali Al Salem Air Base (ASAB), Kuwait; Al Dhafra Air Base (ADAB), United Arab Emirates; Muwaffaq Salti Air Base (MSAB), Jordan; optional placement at Al Udeid Air Base (AUAB), Qatar

The Military Post Office Contractor Program Manager leads contract performance for military postal service operations. This role provides program leadership, operational oversight, customer coordination, staffing management, quality control, and compliance support across assigned Military Post Office (MPO) contracts. The Program Manager ensures reliable, secure, and timely postal services that meet contract requirements, Department of Defense standards, and customer expectations.
As required by our governmental client, this position requires an active SECRET clearance to be considered.

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.
Estimated Starting Salary Range for CPM: TBD
Full-time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, or a closely related discipline and a minimum of five (5) years of program management experience and five (5) years of postal service operations experience; or
A minimum of eight (8) years of military postal service operations experience and five (5) years of program management experience.
Demonstrated experience managing complex operational programs, contracts, teams, budgets, schedules, and customer relationships.
Strong knowledge of military postal service operations, postal accountability procedures, mail handling standards, and customer-service requirements.
Proven ability to lead geographically dispersed teams and perform effectively in a mission-driven, high-tempo environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare reports and brief Government and company leadership.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Must pass a Cherokee Federal Background Check and Drug Screen.
Prior experience supporting Military Post Offices, Army Post Offices, Fleet Post Offices, Diplomatic Post Offices, or other Department of Defense postal operations.

Experience managing federal government service contracts, including compliance with Performance Work Statements, Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans, staffing requirements, and contract deliverables.
Knowledge of MPSA, U.S. Postal Service, DoD, Army, Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, or installation-level postal policies and procedures.
Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), or comparable program-management certification.
Experience leading transition-in, mobilization, or start-up activities for government contracts.
